title: Creative Systems Toolkit
summary: Small tools for testing brand components, patterns, asset production, and accessibility.
overview: A grouped set of small tools built to explore AppOmni's design system at a more granular level than a single page. The Button System Lab distinguishes between observed AppOmni button styles (captured from the live site's CSS, flagged with an "Observed CSS" provenance label on each state), a proposed "off-white" active state that isn't part of the original system, and small custom edits made while building the demo -- plus a per-state color-contrast check, which is not the same as full accessibility testing. The dot-pattern section shows the original AppOmni pattern as it actually appears on the live site, alongside a recreated generative tool for building similar fields. The logo-placement tool searches a small, supplied library of sample SVG marks (four logos from AppOmni's public partner page), not every brand or the open web. The WebP export is a single demonstration result -- one 89% file-size reduction on one sample image -- not a historical AppOmni metric or a universal compression rate.
coverAlt: Recreated "Button System Lab" interface showing six AppOmni button families with per-state color-contrast ratios

gallery.alt: Recreated "Button System Lab" showing six AppOmni button families (primary, light, dark, and their outline variants) with AA text-contrast ratios for each

The original AppOmni dot pattern as it appears on the live AppOmni Press Releases page, used as the visual reference for the recreated tool
